hypotheses.statement: The increase in settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers at 15:55:00Z caused database connection pool exhaustion because the pool size remained at 20, leading to pool_timeout errors affecting ~38% of attempts.

The expiration of the settlement-worker's service token for flags.internal at 15:59:00Z caused 401 invalid_token responses from 15:59:02Z, leading to failures affecting ~31% of attempts, independent of the connection pool issue.

The settlement failure ratio of 0.61 from 16:00Z was caused by the combined effect of both the connection pool exhaustion and the service token expiry, with each contributing a distinct subset of failures.

observed_facts.statement: Configuration change at 15:55:00Z raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers, while the database connection pool size remained at 20.
From 15:58:10Z, settlement-worker experienced database connection pool exhaustion (pool size 20, checked-out 20) with pool_timeout errors affecting ~0.38 of attempts.
The service token settlement-worker uses for flags.internal expired at 15:59:00Z on 2026-02-11, having been issued for 90 days on 2025-11-13 without automated renewal.
From 15:59:02Z, settlement-worker calls to flags.internal returned 401 invalid_token, affecting ~0.31 of attempts, overlapping with pool_timeout failures.
Alert settlement-failures fired at 16:00:44Z as settlement attempts failing reached 0.61 against an objective of 0.02, clearing at 18:12:30Z.
INC-2201 opened at 16:05:00Z with severity 1, title 'Settlements failing', recording no settlement value at risk.
At 17:20:15Z, settlement-worker connection pool raised to 64, pool_timeout errors stopped, and failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29.
Settlement failure ratio series: 0.61 from 16:00Z, stepping down to 0.29 at 17:20Z and to 0.004 at 18:12Z, showing two distinct step changes.
At 18:12:10Z, a replacement token for flags.internal was installed, 401 responses stopped, and settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.

open_questions.missing_evidence: Documentation or configuration management records explaining why database connection pool size is not derived from worker concurrency.
open_questions.question: Why is the database connection pool size not derived from worker concurrency?

open_questions.missing_evidence: An audit report listing all service tokens, their renewal policies, and automation status.
open_questions.question: Which other service tokens are on manual renewal and require auditing?

summary: Incident dual-cause-payments involved two simultaneous, independent faults: (1) database connection pool exhaustion due to increased worker concurrency without pool adjustment, and (2) expired service token for feature-flag service. The combined effect caused a settlement failure ratio of 0.61. The pool issue was resolved by increasing pool size at 17:20Z, reducing failures to 0.29. The token issue was resolved by token replacement at 18:12Z, restoring normal operation.
